# RefineUI

> Pelagornis design system: `@refineui/tokens` (Foundation variables) and `@refineui/react` (Web Kit components). Docs use real package output, not mockups.

Install: `bun add @refineui/react @refineui/tokens`. Load `@refineui/tokens/tailwind.css`, `@refineui/web-icons/dist/fonts/refineui-system-icons.css`, and `@refineui/react/refineui.css` at the app root.

## Guides

- [Getting started](https://refineui.dev/getting-started/): Architecture, install, stylesheet, first example
- [AI integration](https://refineui.dev/ai-integration/): llm.txt, Cursor docs, prompt patterns

## Foundations

- [Overview](https://refineui.dev/foundations/): Visual language and token model
- [Design tokens](https://refineui.dev/foundations/design-tokens/): Semantic token introduction
- [Color](https://refineui.dev/foundations/color/): Palette and alias colors
- [Typography](https://refineui.dev/foundations/typography/): Type scale and roles
- [Spacing](https://refineui.dev/foundations/spacing/): Padding and gap scale
- [Sizing](https://refineui.dev/foundations/sizing/): Dimension tokens
- [Radius](https://refineui.dev/foundations/radius/): Corner radius
- [Border](https://refineui.dev/foundations/border/): Stroke widths and borders
- [Elevation](https://refineui.dev/foundations/elevation/): Shadows and depth
- [Opacity](https://refineui.dev/foundations/opacity/): Opacity and overlays
- [Motion](https://refineui.dev/foundations/motion/): Duration, easing, distance
- [Z-index](https://refineui.dev/foundations/z-index/): Layering scale
- [Layout](https://refineui.dev/foundations/layout/): Container, grid, alignment, responsive layout
- [Iconography](https://github.com/pelagornis/refineui-system-icons): System icons (external repo)
